test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A certain number of persons are standing in a straight row facing North. X is standing to the immediate left of W but immediate right of R. Z is standing to the immediate left of R. There is only one person to the left of P. Q is standing to the immediate left of Y. The person standing at the extreme right end is the only person to the right of Y. Only four persons are standing between P and Q. If no other person is standing in the row, what is the total number of persons standing?
solution:
Given → A certain number of persons are standing in a straight row facing North.

 
• X is standing to the immediate left of W but immediate right of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f034f268c84a1d0c09d86fe79b896401a4b899a975189cf727da111f2fd0075e.png] 

 
• Z is standing to the immediate left of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02b5649d7f63fcb340d6112e2cdbf6b3d64ce71dba7237b4b0292dcde6bd2063.png] 

 
• There is only one person to the left of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ffedacc78f0c1aabda65f4ff46ab49deeac0b943801de4dfb7742e335d397358.png] 

 
• Only four persons are standing between P and Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5912896b645ae515b98e8e78b42643175aaf4d5fd705816a7457fe0af4835635.png] 

 
• Q is standing to the immediate left of Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89ab4b93a39aa32a4417d31ee56b4e39a72d791d8ca4b4a06231f1c24416172f.png] 

 
• The person standing at the extreme right end is the only person to the right of Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25ad16b0e56229cd7d681f5e08427ff82ec5603ed64cfbe08a09d616de730b8a.png] 

 
• The final arrangement after seating all the people.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d008315bb533fcbf7a63319507835d5762be370bace81f2f82f33885e659a0e0.png] 

From the above arrangement, it can be seen that nine people are standing in the row facing north.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Nine".**
